name: Save the Kiwi Annual Funding Grant
summary: Grants to community kiwi conservation groups and research bodies in Aotearoa New Zealand for kiwi recovery work such as predator control, habitat and population work, and research that benefits kiwi.

steps: Save the Kiwi Board of Trustees approves final allocations

eligibility.rule: If an organisation: university, zoo, research body, charity, incorporated society, kiwi or Landcare group
The proposed work is not undertaken by the Department of Conservation
For multi-year funding, the project has operated successfully for at least three years
For multi-year funding, the project has measures in place to show effectiveness

documents: Organisation business plan and budget, for multi-year funding

status.quote: Applications will open 1 April and close 9pm 30 April 2026.

opens.quote: Applications will open 1 April and close 9pm 30 April 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications will open 1 April and close 9pm 30 April 2026.

applicant_types.quote: All community-based kiwi conservation groups, universities, and recognised research facilities can apply for funding from Save the Kiwi, if they meet our terms and conditions.

geography.quote: We are proud to support kiwi conservation projects all over Aotearoa.

access.quote: Applications will only be accepted via our online portal at this link.

window.quote: Applications will open 1 April and close 9pm 30 April 2026.

effort.quote: Applications will only be accepted via our online portal
Applications are assessed by the Kiwi Recovery Group members.
Applications will open 1 April and close 9pm 30 April 2026.
Recommendations are made to the Save the Kiwi Board of Trustees, who approve the final allocations.

eligibility.quote: University, zoo and/or recognised research facility Registered charitable trust, charitable foundation, or charitable organisation Incorporated society Kiwi conservation group, association, or society Landcare group
Work undertaken by the Department of Conservation is not eligible for funding from Save the Kiwi.
The project has been successfully operational for three or more years.
Projects must have in place measurements to prove effectiveness.

after_award.quote: The funded organisation will provide to Save the Kiwi an interim progress report on the project no later than 9th April in the financial year for which funding is provided, and a final report no later than 30th July at the conclusion of the financial year for which funding was provided.
The funded organisation will provide reasonable access to the project as requested by the Trust's executive director, trustees and/or regional coordinators.

documents.quote: Your organisation has a business plan and budget. Please supply these in the supporting documents when applying for funding.
